name: Firecrawl
shortDescription: Turns websites into markdown for LLMs. Open-source repo plus a cloud API with a free plan.
longDescription: Firecrawl crawls pages into markdown for language models. The free plan includes 1,000 credits per month. Paid plans start at $19 per month, or $16 per month when billed annually.
pricingNotes: OSS repo exists; cloud has paid tiers (samples $16/$75 etc.).
bestFor: Turning pages into clean text for retrieval
Teams that want either a cloud API or an open-source repo
notIdealFor: Interactive browser tasks such as clicking and login flows
A general web-search API, which is a different job
strength: The free cloud plan includes 1,000 credits per month to turn pages into markdown, and the repo is open source.
weakness: Paid plans start at $19 per month, or $16 per month when billed annually.

useCaseFit.tool-use-browser: Turns website pages into markdown an agent can read, with a free cloud plan.
useCaseFit.research-rag: Turns source pages into markdown so an agent can quote the page it fetched.
